title: Is cold exposure a viable lifestyle intervention for mental health? Reviewing evidence and mechanisms
title_zh: 冷暴露是否可作为心理健康的可行生活方式干预？证据与机制综述
abstract: Abstract Cold exposure has gained substantial popularity as a wellness intervention, with growing public interest in its potential to alleviate symptoms of depression, anxiety, and stress-related disorders. While early observational studies and anecdotal reports suggest mental health benefits, the empirical evidence remains limited and methodologically inconsistent. This review critically evaluates the current state of research on cold exposure and mental health, with a focus on three key physiological systems implicated in its proposed effects: the catecholamine system, the hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal (HPA) axis, and immune-inflammatory pathways. We examine evidence from randomized controlled trials (RCTs), observational studies, and translational models, highlighting both promising findings—such as acute mood enhancement and stress modulation—and persistent uncertainties regarding mechanism and clinical relevance. Despite theoretical plausibility and preliminary support, existing studies are hindered by small sample sizes, heterogeneous protocols, lack of active placebo controls, and selection bias stemming from self-selected, health-motivated participants. Psychological improvements reported in several studies have not been consistently linked to objective biological changes. We conclude that cold exposure represents a promising, yet still unproven, adjunct for mood regulation. Future research should prioritize standardized protocols, active control conditions, and recruitment of clinical populations to clarify its therapeutic potential and underlying mechanisms.
abstract_zh: 摘要：冷暴露作为一种健康干预手段已获得广泛关注，公众对其缓解抑郁、焦虑和压力相关障碍症状的潜力兴趣日益增长。尽管早期观察性研究和轶事报告提示心理健康益处，但实证证据仍有限且方法学不一致。本综述批判性评估了冷暴露与心理健康研究的现状，重点关注其所涉及的三大关键生理系统：儿茶酚胺系统、下丘脑-垂体-肾上腺（HPA）轴以及免疫-炎症通路。我们检视了随机对照试验（RCT）、观察性研究和转化模型的证据，突出显示了积极发现——如急性情绪提升和压力调节——以及关于机制和临床相关性的持续不确定性。尽管理论上可行且有初步支持，现有研究受限于样本量小、方案异质、缺乏活性安慰剂对照以及自选、健康动机参与者导致的选择偏倚。多项研究报告的心理改善尚未与客观生物学变化一致关联。我们得出结论，冷暴露是一个有前景但尚未得到证实的情绪调节辅助方法。未来研究应优先制定标准化方案、活性对照条件，并招募临床人群，以阐明其治疗潜力及潜在机制。
